  v3-product-integration-checks:
    name: v3-product-integration-checks
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      GOTOOLCHAIN: local
      GOWORK: 'off'
      GOFLAGS: '-mod=readonly'
      GOTELEMETRY: 'off'
      GOMAXPROCS: '2'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
        with:
          go-version: '1.26.5'
          check-latest: false
          cache: false
      - name: Required HTTP, raw writer, generation and Drain inventory
        run: bash scripts/ci/iu-checks.sh
      - name: Preserve exact root execution evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: iu-encoder-root-events-${{ github.sha }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/iu-*.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

  v3-manual-auto-start-hold-checks:
    name: v3-manual-auto-start-hold-checks
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 45
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      GOTOOLCHAIN: local
      GOWORK: 'off'
      GOFLAGS: '-mod=readonly'
      GOTELEMETRY: 'off'
      GOMAXPROCS: '2'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e
        with:
          go-version: '1.26.5'
          check-latest: false
          cache: false
      - name: Required target HTTP, prelaunch, restart and process Barrier roots
        run: bash scripts/ci/msr-checks.sh
      - name: Preserve exact MSR root execution evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: manual-auto-start-hold-${{ github.sha }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/msr-*.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
